Company Information
Greeting from the President
Greeting from the President
Representative Director Koji Matsubara
Located in the mountainous area of Akechicho, Ena City, Gifu Prefecture (home to Nihon Taisho Village), we are a company with a 73-year history as a specialty printing business that includes
    labels, stickers, silkscreen printing, metals, and more. With our “quality first” approach and having obtained international certification for quality assurance, including ISO 9001 in April 2007
    and ISO 14001 in June 2008, we are proud of the trust and confidence that we have earned from our customers.
Though the specialized printing industry is said to be in decline these days due to increasing awareness of environmental issues, labels and stickers can still be found all around us.
Under these circumstances, we aim to provide products that are both “high quality” and “low cost” by fully utilizing our experience and technology cultivated in the field of low-voltage
    electrical components and automotive parts, and by seeing things from our customers’ perspective in order to meet their needs.
Hobbies:　Golf
Driving & eating around
If I hear that a certain restaurant is good, no matter how far away it is, my wife and I will spare no time or effort to go there.lol
